text.tspan: Primary, secondary and tertiary education enrollment and completion
This is given as the gross ratio, which includes children of any age entering the level of education; this can result in
percentages greater than 100 because children may enter education late or repeat a year.
Data source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026)
